title: Missing netty-transport-native-* entries in the bom can lead to mismatched versions
body:
### Expected behavior

Netty's bom provides dependency management for all of Netty's modules, thereby ensuring that a consistent version is used.

### Actual behavior

Netty's bom does not include dependency management for:

- `netty-transport-native-epoll`
- `netty-transport-native-kqueue`
- `netty-transport-native-unix-common`

This can lead to mismatched version of Netty's modules when using the bom to control their versions

### Steps to reproduce

1. Depend on something that uses Netty, including one of the `transport-native` modules listed above
2. Import Netty's bom to control the version of Netty that's used

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

	<groupId>com.example</groupId>
	<artifactId>netty-bom-problem</artifactId>
	<version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
	<packaging>jar</packaging>

	<name>netty-bom-problem</name>

	<dependencyManagement>
		<dependencies>
			<dependency>
				<groupId>io.netty</groupId>
				<artifactId>netty-bom</artifactId>
				<version>4.1.11.Final</version>
				<type>pom</type>
				<scope>import</scope>
			</dependency>
		</dependencies>
	</dependencyManagement>

	<dependencies>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>io.projectreactor.ipc</groupId>
			<artifactId>reactor-netty</artifactId>
			<version>0.6.3.RELEASE</version>
		</dependency>
	</dependencies>

</project>
```
 
This pom yields the following dependencies:

```
[INFO] The following files have been resolved:
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-common:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-handler:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.projectreactor:reactor-core:jar:3.0.7.RELEASE:compile
[INFO]    org.reactivestreams:reactive-streams:jar:1.0.0:compile
[INFO]    io.projectreactor.ipc:reactor-ipc:jar:0.6.2.RELEASE:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-codec-http:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-buffer:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-codec:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-codec-socks:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.projectreactor.ipc:reactor-netty:jar:0.6.3.RELEASE:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-transport-native-epoll:jar:4.1.9.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-transport:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-handler-proxy:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
[INFO]    io.netty:netty-resolver:jar:4.1.11.Final:compile
```

Note that all of the Netty's modules are 4.1.11.Final except for `io.netty:netty-transport-native-epoll` which is 4.1.9.Final

### Netty version

4.1.11.Final (earlier versions are also affected)

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)

N/A

### OS version (e.g. `uname -a`)

N/A
